verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents an official MCP server, which lets a coding agent call the scanner directly. Its site claims it can 'scan and fix AI-generated code the moment it's written.' It also offers a login-free local CLI and pre-commit hooks that can gate code before it lands. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP server's tools and agent setup (evidence is only a probe pointer plus marketing copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-loop scanning.
